declaration.mitigation: Operator-invoked provisioning only (management command prints DDL; nothing runs on deploy, migrate or update). Statements create a read-only definer/principal, a per-principal view database, SELECT grants and RESTRICTIVE row policies; no ALTER/DROP/INSERT on existing tables, no data rewrite. Rollback: DROP the created users, row policies and view database.

Forward-only metadata repair. CREATE OR REPLACE DICTIONARY for trace_dict, end_users_dict and trace_sessions_dict, byte-identical to 015/017/018, runs ON CLUSTER through the fixed rewriter so every replica holds the dictionaries. No source table is altered, rewritten or replayed; each replica loads the dictionary the way the first replica already does. Rollback: the identical earlier definitions. Exercised on two-replica production-chart rehearsals (17 and 18 Nov).

Replicated-mode rewriter now appends ON CLUSTER to CREATE [OR REPLACE] DICTIONARY [IF NOT EXISTS], with the same object-name grammar as tables and MVs. Table, MV and ALTER handling is unchanged. Affects only dictionary DDL over traces, end_users and trace_sessions (read by spans via dictGet). Exercised with 028 on two-replica production-chart rehearsals (17 and 18 Nov).
